Name: excuse me i love you Movie
Author: MyCastlesCrumbling
Description:
[b]THIS MOD DOES NOT WORK ON 1.6. WHEN CUSTOM MOVIES UPDATES, THIS WILL TOO. <3

excuse me, i love you[/b] | by Ariana Grande
Includes all sets, and all songs included from excuse me, i love you off of Netflix.

Alex and Sandy Love this film.

Each song has its own frame with a random lyric from the song, with Stardew Valley Music randomly playing over each song.

This Film is shown in Winter, based off the real release.
(I believe the 2nd-3rd Week of Winter)

Thanks to @kahluagames for the request!
